name: Yoru
source:
A "Star Child" who is a candidate to success the "Star God".

He is cheerful and bright, but can't help but be a little dissatisfied that he wasn't chosen to be the next "Star God." Even so, if Aka is chosen, he'll play the role of an attendant.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/hoshikuzu.html]official website[/url]]
